_about: Props for the room beyond the switchboard. Same form as switchboard.json; a dev session copies 'props' into game/content/props.json when props-by-name lands.

props.name: The ad board
props.what: A cork board on the wall right of the front door, inside. Leaflets for your own service pinned in a row; the weekly cost and this week's bookings pencilled underneath. E pins one up, R takes one down (D37).
props.charm: The first leaflet is hand-lettered with a phone number crossed out and rewritten; the later ones are photocopies, slightly crooked.
takes: bodge: one leaflet held by tape instead of a pin
